name: Industrial
description: Plant floor: 2px machined corners, 2px outlines in the strong border color, rules dashed like marked floor lanes, plates with a lit top edge and a shadowed bottom lip, chunky 44px controls, heavy ease-in motion with a press that sinks, brushed-metal surfaces, and a grid texture on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's industrial recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: Translucent surfaces with a backdrop blur cost paint time on slower devices, and read less clearly over busy content.
A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

Ships opaque: its approved 96% translucent surfaces fall under the contrast targets with its texture over a black or white backdrop, so its surfaces are 100% opaque, and only a dialog's backdrop is blurred. This supersedes the translucency caveats above.

tokens.shadow-card: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 50%, transparent), inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 20%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 50%, transparent), inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 20%, transparent), 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent)
